audit_note: This ledger intentionally records zero sensitivity variants. The Elo baseline's configuration was chosen from documented prior practice (FiveThirtyEight and Tango constants for HFA, K, and MOV) and is not tuned on the development data.
tuning_policy: No hyperparameter tuning performed. The primary configuration is frozen in config/qb_elo_v1.yaml. Per the policy in docs/modeling_gap_report.md and the parameter policy in config/qb_elo_v1.yaml, this baseline permitted one frozen primary configuration plus a very small sensitivity audit (~3 variants max). No broad hyperparameter mining was performed.
